Local Government Act 1972, section 1(1): "For the administration of local government on and after 1st April 1974 England (exclusive of Greater London and the Isles of Scilly) shall be divided into local government areas to be known as counties", with Avon among the new counties of Schedule 1

The Avon (Structural Change) Order 1995 (SI 1995/493), article 5(1): "The existing county of Avon and the existing Avon districts of Bath, Wansdyke, Kingswood and Northavon shall be abolished", on the reorganisation date, 1st April 1996

The Avon (Structural Change) Order 1995 (SI 1995/493), article 6(1): "New counties of North West Somerset, Bath and North East Somerset, South Gloucestershire and the City of Bristol". North West Somerset is the authority WOF records as North Somerset (1360699111).
